command:
cat > /etc/init.d/lvm-data <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

description="Attach and mount the persistent loop-backed data LV"
backing_file="/var/lib/lvm-data-pv.img"
vg_name="vg_data"
lv_path="/dev/vg_data/lv_data"
mount_dir="/srv/data"

depend() {
    need localmount
    after modules
}

start() {
    ebegin "Activating ${lv_path} on ${mount_dir}"
    loopdev=$(losetup -j "${backing_file}" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
    if [ -z "${loopdev}" ]; then
        loopdev=$(losetup --find --show "${backing_file}") || return 1
    fi
    pvscan --cache "${loopdev}" >/dev/null || return 1
    vgchange -ay "${vg_name}" >/dev/null || return 1
    mkdir -p "${mount_dir}"
    if ! mountpoint -q "${mount_dir}"; then
        mount "${lv_path}" "${mount_dir}" || return 1
    fi
    eend 0
}

stop() {
    ebegin "Deactivating ${lv_path}"
    if mountpoint -q "${mount_dir}"; then
        umount "${mount_dir}" || return 1
    fi
    vgchange -an "${vg_name}" >/dev/null || return 1
    loopdev=$(losetup -j "${backing_file}" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
    if [ -n "${loopdev}" ]; then
        losetup -d "${loopdev}" || return 1
    fi
    eend 0
}
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 755 /etc/init.d/lvm-data
rc-update add lvm-data default
rc-service lvm-data start
rc-update show default | grep lvm-data
rc-service lvm-data status
